# Extract all user_query timestamps for Sep 16 from all transcripts
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts")
pat=re.compile(r"<timestamp>(.*?)</timestamp>.*?<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>", re.S)
for p in sorted(root.rglob("*.jsonl"), key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime):
    texts=[]
    for line in p.open(errors='ignore'):
        if "user_query" not in line and '"role": "user"' not in line: 
            continue
        try: o=json.loads(line)
        except: continue
        if o.get("role")!="user": continue
        content=o.get("message",{}).get("content")
        if isinstance(content,list):
            t="\n".join(c.get("text","") for c in content if isinstance(c,dict))
        else:
            t=str(content)
        m=re.search(r"<timestamp>(.*?)</timestamp>", t)
        ts=m.group(1) if m else ""
        if "Sep 16, 2026" not in ts and "2026-09-16" not in t[:200]:
            continue
        qm=re.search(r"<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>", t, re.S)
        q=(qm.group(1) if qm else t)[:200].replace("\n"," ")
        texts.append((ts,q))
    if texts:
        print("FILE", p.parent.name)
        for ts,q in texts:
            print(" ", ts, "|", q[:180])
PY
